description: Pick a base image, workdir, RUN steps, ports, and CMD to get a clean, working Dockerfile.

faqs.a: Base image, WORKDIR, COPY, ENV, RUN steps, EXPOSE ports, and CMD in exec form.
Each line of the RUN box becomes its own RUN instruction, in order.
faqs.q: How do multiple RUN commands work?

faqs.a: CMD is emitted in exec (JSON array) form; separate arguments with spaces or commas.
Yes — copy it or download it as Dockerfile.

howto: Choose a base image and working directory.
Add COPY, RUN, ENV, and EXPOSE entries.
Click Generate — copy or download the Dockerfile.
title: Dockerfile Generator
